{"prompt":"[@Image 1]: Nhân vật nữ chính (Linh). Giữ chuẩn xác 100% ngũ quan khuôn mặt, ánh mắt có chiều sâu cảm xúc, mái tóc đen tự nhiên, làn da thật, vóc dáng và bộ váy tối màu thanh lịch cùng phụ kiện đã duyệt trong ảnh.

[@Image 2]: Nhân vật nam chính (Minh). Giữ đúng cấu trúc khuôn mặt góc cạnh nam tính, kiểu tóc ngắn gọn gàng, vóc dáng và trang phục áo sơ mi casual trong ảnh đã duyệt.

[@Image 3]: Bối cảnh bãi cỏ sườn đê cạnh cầu thang bê tông, bờ sông đêm phản chiếu ánh đèn le lói, bầu trời đêm sao mờ và ánh trăng mát lạnh.

[@Image 4]: Lối đi trên đỉnh đê và các bậc thang dẫn xuống vị trí bãi cỏ cạnh sông.

CINEMATIC MASTERPIECE (15-SECOND CONTINUOUS LIVE-ACTION SCENE, 16:9 4K CINEMATIC TEXTURE):
Filmed on Arri Alexa Mini LF, 35mm & 50mm Master Prime lenses, natural optical depth of field, authentic subtle film grain. Real human micro-textures: genuine skin pores, authentic skin translucency, individual loose hair strands reacting naturally to river breeze, realistic fabric drape and weight. Absolute zero beauty filters, no waxy plastic skin, no 3D game rendering, no morphing artifacts.

NIGHT LIGHTING & ATMOSPHERE:
Soft cool directional moonlight (5600K key light) casting delicate highlights on character silhouettes and riverside grass, paired with restrained warm ambient spill (2800K) from distant streetlamps. Natural contrast, rich shadow gradations, preserving real skin tones in low-light conditions.

CHOREOGRAPHED SHOT TIMELINE (0.00s – 15.00s):
• 0.00–5.00s (Establishing Emotion & Atmosphere):
Wide establishing three-quarter shot (35mm lens, f/2.2). The camera begins a very subtle, steady tracking push-in toward the riverbank. In the lower-right foreground, Linh [@Image 1] sits quietly on the grass near the staircase landing, looking out over the water. Her seated weight naturally compresses the grass beneath her dress. She gently dabs beneath her eye with her fingertips, swallowing a quiet sigh. In the background along the top dyke path, Minh [@Image 2] enters the frame, walking forward at a natural, casual pace under distant streetlights.

• 5.00–8.00s (Recognition & Hesitant Call):
Smooth cut to an eye-level medium tracking shot (50mm lens, shallow depth of field) focusing on Minh [@Image 2]. Noticing the familiar figure sitting alone, his walking pace slows to a halt. His shoulders settle, his expression turning from casual to gentle surprise and concern. Pausing at the upper landing, he leans slightly forward and speaks softly with precise lip-sync: “Linh?” (soft, authentic northern Vietnamese conversational tone, not shouting).

• 8.00–15.00s (Over-The-Shoulder Connection & Subtle Interaction):
Reverse over-the-shoulder shot from behind Minh’s shoulder looking down at Linh [@Image 1]. Minh’s shoulder frames the left edge with soft bokeh; Linh’s face is rendered razor-sharp. Startled by his voice, Linh turns her head up, recognition flashing in her expressive eyes. She quickly brushes her cheek and answers with natural lip movement: “Ơ… anh Minh.” He asks gently: “Sao em ngồi đây?” She casts her eyes briefly toward the shimmering river before replying with a bittersweet, shy breath: “Em ra hóng gió tí.” A gentle night breeze lifts loose strands of her hair. At 13.00–15.00s, Minh takes two deliberate, careful steps down the staircase toward her as she looks back toward the river, concluding on a poignant, unresolved emotional beat.

AUDIO & SOUND DESIGN:
Authentic riverside night ambient audio (gentle wind, faint river ripples, distant soft cicadas, stone footsteps). Clean, natural conversational Vietnamese dialogue spoken exclusively by the active character in natural northern accent, perfectly matched with lip animation. No extra dialogue, no background music, no subtitles, no sudden exposure change, no black transition, no freezing.","image":"/api/files/prj_06d6f1c9496a/asset_a3e66197873f-image.png.png","images":["/api/files/prj_06d6f1c9496a/asset_a3e66197873f-image.png.png","/api/files/prj_06d6f1c9496a/asset_a89400cc3de4-image.png.png","/api/files/prj_06d6f1c9496a/asset_c501d59025f7-image.png.png","/api/files/prj_06d6f1c9496a/asset_0d57f8ce9c10-image.png.png"],"modelImage":"/api/files/prj_06d6f1c9496a/inline_382fc4be59b960cd859a.png","garmentImage":"/api/files/prj_06d6f1c9496a/inline_4e11c3e6403598916da6.png","video":"/api/files/assets/asset_seedance25_1793710136335.mp4","videoUrl":"/api/files/assets/asset_seedance25_1793710136335.mp4","workflowId":"","duration":15,"aspect":"16:9","size":"1280x720","seed":705819,"scale":2,"imageUrls":["/api/files/prj_06d6f1c9496a/asset_a3e66197873f-image.png.png","/api/files/prj_06d6f1c9496a/asset_a89400cc3de4-image.png.png","/api/files/prj_06d6f1c9496a/asset_c501d59025f7-image.png.png","/api/files/prj_06d6f1c9496a/asset_0d57f8ce9c10-image.png.png"],"piapiMode":"omni_reference","piapiDuration":15,"piapiAspect":"16:9","resolution":"720p"}
